question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mn>1</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mn>4</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mn>4</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> are four points which are at unit distance from the lines <math><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math><mfrac><mrow><mrow><munderover><mo stretchy="true">∑</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></munderover><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow><mrow><mrow><munderover><mo stretchy="true">∑</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></munderover><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfrac></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Point of intersection of lines 3x-4y+1=0 and 8x+6y+1=0 is -15,110
Now, ∑i=14xi=4-15=-45
and ∑i=14yi=4110=25
⇒∑i=14xi∑i=14yi=-4525=-2
